title: WorkroomRcaClaim
description: CDM EventEnvelope profile for DevSecOps Workroom RCA claims / verdicts / findings. Encodes conformance requirements C2/C4/C5/C7/C9: a claim is Event-IR (EventEnvelope-shaped), carries epistemicLevel + calibrated uncertainty (S3, not boolean), an evidence-integrity manifest (S1 native provenance), space coords + proof ref (S2 three-space), and a membrane decision (execution separation / manifest-gate).

epistemicLevel.description: S3 six-state gradient — strict superset of CoE booleans

uncertainty.description: calibrated uncertainty carried to the decision surface (not collapsed)

evidence_integrity.description: S1 evidence-grade capture: every claim is backed by a hashed evidence bundle (native provenance, not post-hoc)

space_coords.description: S2 three-space grounding — reproducible semantic anchors

proof_artifact_ref.description: S2 signed analyzer ProofArtifact reference (to the receipt spine)

membrane_decision_ref.description: C1/C9 MembraneDecision receipt — no authority without a gate decision

authority_sources.description: C9 — ALL authority incl. static/curated (allowlists/seed sets) declared + manifest-gated; no default-trusted exemption
